mapper.select: SELECT tweet_id, author, post_text, image_url, tweet_created_at FROM gallery_post WHERE x_user_profile_id = #{xUserProfileId} ORDER BY tweet_created_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gallery_post (x_user_profile_id, tweet_id, author, post_text, image_url, tweet_created_at) VALUES ( #{xUserProfileId}, #{post.tweetId}, #{post.author}, #{post.text}, #{post.imageUrl}, #{post.createdAt} )
